model_channel_requirement: Every live intent and reply case must complete its model channel; fallback is reported separately.
knowledge_requirement: Expected status, expected source, exact quotation integrity, grounded method and every predeclared content pattern must pass. No source-excerpt fallback counts as a pass.
limitations: New authored regression inputs with corpus-derived expectations. This is not a human-labelled external holdout or independent legal/policy validation.
